title:
Listens for `DATA_ZOOM_START_VALUE_UPDATE` actions, and updates the field:
- {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#selectedChartDate}.
After the new dates are set, the epic will call the {@link UpdateSelectedModelForTagDetailComponentsEpic} that will
call the chart specified on the payload to be re-rendered.

Expected payload:
- `chartId`: The ID of the chart component.
name: UpdateSelectedDatesForTagDetailComponentsEpic
